item.title: Wisdom Funeral, Fatal Crash Charge, Power Grid Apology
item.ns0:title: Wisdom Funeral, Fatal Crash Charge, Power Grid Apology
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, political leaders and citizens gather to pay their final respects to former Cabinet Minister Neville Wisdom as his life and national legacy are celebrated. A 61-year-old driver is behind bars on vehicular manslaughter charges following a tragic collision that claimed the life of a police officer. Plus, energy officials defend ongoing efforts to stabilize the national power grid ahead of major technical upgrades, while travelers get a first look at brand-new luxury airport lounges opening at LPIA. Tune in for all these stories, local sports updates, and your complete weekend weather forecast.
